pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark-brown regions exhibiting sharp edge gradients and high angularity on the cervical region, transitioning to larger, slightly more rounded geometric shapes on the lateral flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways with uniform pixel thickness; topological nodes are predominantly characterized by tri-directional intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the dorsal neck, representing a continuous, short, and rigid mane profile.

other_distinctive_markers: Two symbiotic avian organisms (oxpeckers) are perched on the subject: one on the upper cervical region and one on the mid-dorsal ridge.
